sentences.en: Outsiders tend to scoff at Esperanto as an idealistic waste of time.
sentences.zh: 局外人往往嘲笑世界语是一种理想主义的浪费时间。

sentences.en: Don't let outsiders in. We've only got food and water for us.
sentences.zh: 别让外面的人进来。我们只有食物和水供自己使用。

sentences.en: The outsiders don't quit their philosophy of novelties.
sentences.zh: 那些局外人不会放弃他们对新奇事物的哲学理念。

senses.zh: 局外人，圈外人；无取胜希望者；（比赛中的）冷门选手
